authoritative_fantasy_universe.rule: Every player in the authoritative 162-player fantasy universe must have an explicit review result. Missing review is a blocking failure.

impact_player_scope.rule: Each team must have an explicit impact-player injury review for expected starters and materially important rotation players whose health can affect team offense, team defense, DST, spreads, totals or player props.

rules: Roster-driven matching is mandatory: source corpus is matched against the entire authoritative fantasy universe, not the other way around.
Absence from injury sources may only yield NO_MATERIAL_CAMP_INJURY_FOUND after the all-camp source sweep has been completed through captured_through.
Earlier injury states are retained; latest verified state controls current availability/context.
No injury headline directly changes projection weight without an existing deterministic availability rule or validated coefficient.
Post-2026-08-30 roster/PUP/NFI reconciliation remains mandatory before Step 6.5B closure.
